title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide
description: Offline static guide for all 55 official PS5 trophies in Grand Theft Auto VI. Complete checklist with localStorage persistence, export/import, filters, spoiler toggle, detail views, and 6-phase roadmap to platinum.
author: maxinung
features: Spoiler toggle: hides story trophy details until earned
Detail view per trophy with guide & source link
Roadmap to platinum (6 phases, 55 trophies organized)
Dark theme, responsive, system fonts only

screenshots.view: Main trophy list (all 55, spoilers off, HTTP server)
Platinum trophy 'Vice Got a Price!' detail (1280x1000, HTTP server)
6-phase roadmap to platinum (spoilers off, no header overlap, HTTP server)
Missable-only filter (7 trophies, spoilers off, HTTP server)
